evidence.snippet: const db = await SQLite.openDatabase({ name: DATABASE_NAME, location: 'default' });
evidence.why: Opens a plain unencrypted SQLite database with no encryption key or secure storage layer

evidence.snippet: email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, phone_number TEXT NOT NULL,
evidence.why: PII (email, phone number) is stored in cleartext columns in the unencrypted SQLite database
Sensitive PII is written directly to the unencrypted on-disk database file
